intentions: Design a responsive GUI for managing wine inventory and storage locations with intuitive user interaction
Ensure data persistence across application sessions using local storage
Enforce separation of concerns: UI layer, data access layer, and domain logic layer
Model wine bottles with unique identifiers, attributes, and a one-to-one assignment to storage locations
Model storage locations with zone, row, shelf, and capacity constraints
Validate business rules: pricing, stock levels, uniqueness, and capacity limits
Raise custom domain exceptions for violations of business rules
Provide clear, user-friendly error messages during input validation and constraint enforcement
